review_text: Used to love it. Now the dashboard takes half a minute to load every morning while my coffee gets cold. Fix the speed and I'll change this to 5 stars.
4.12.1 crashes constantly during scan sessions. Unusable in the warehouse. Reverted to old version.
Nice product once you're in, but the first-week experience is rough. Took me three days to figure out how to invite my team and import products. Needs a real getting-started guide.
Solid feature set. Only gripe: the main dashboard has gotten noticeably slower over the last month, ~20 seconds on our account.
Billing is a mess. Got invoiced for seats we removed in June. Support fixed it but it shouldn't happen.
Perfect for my one-person consultancy. Zero complaints.
Calendar tab crashes the iPad app every single time since the update. Front office staff back to paper.
Good tool but dashboards are getting slower every release. 25s load on a fast office connection is not okay.

Does what we need. Setup was confusing though — the wizard assumes you have an IT person. We're an HOA, we don't.
